class="share-markdown" data-sentry-component="Markdown" data-sentry-source-file="markdown.tsx"><p class="share-markdownParagraph">The International Brock Scholars Award at Brock University offers substantial financial support to high-achieving international students based on their admission average. This scholarship recognizes academic excellence and helps reduce the cost of education for eligible students.</p><h2 class="share-markdownHeadlineM">Award Amounts and Eligibility Criteria</h2><p class="share-markdownParagraph">The scholarship amounts are determined by the applicant's final admission average, calculated using the prerequisites for their offered program of study. The awards are subject to annual approval by the Board of Trustees and are offered at the time of admission. The award amount may be adjusted if the final average changes.</p><ul class="share-markdownList"><li><strong>95.0% and above:</strong> Up to $32,000 total</li><li>Year 1: $20,000</li><li>Renewals: $4,000 per year</li><li><strong>90.0% – 94.9%:</strong> Up to $24,000 total</li><li>Year 1: $15,000</li><li>Renewals: $3,000 per year</li><li><strong>85.0% – 89.9%:</strong> Up to $12,500 total</li><li>Year 1: $8,000</li><li>Renewals: $1,500 per year</li><li><strong>80.0% – 84.9%:</strong> Up to $7,000 total</li><li>Year 1: $4,000</li><li>Renewals: $1,000 per year</li></ul><h2 class="share-markdownHeadlineM">Renewal Conditions</h2><p class="share-markdownParagraph">The Brock Scholars Award is renewable for up to three years. Students enrolled in a three-year degree program are eligible for two renewals after the initial award year, supporting continued academic success throughout their studies.</p><h2 class="share-markdownHeadlineM">Special Notes</h2><ul class="share-markdownList"><li>Students entering from the U.S.A. qualify for the Domestic Brock Scholars Entrance Award instead of the International award.</li><li>International students who change their status to domestic students will have their International Brock Scholars Award converted accordingly to align with domestic fees.</li></ul><p class="share-markdownParagraph">This scholarship is an excellent opportunity for international students demonstrating academic excellence to secure significant funding for their studies at Brock University. Prospective applicants should check their eligibility based on their admission average and apply early to maximize their chances of receiving this prestigious award.</p></div></section><section><h2 class="scholarship-sectionTitle">Eligible nationalities</h2><p class="scholarship-sectionText">All nationalities</p></section><section><h2 class="scholarship-sectionTitle">Eligible program levels</h2><ul class="scholarship-levelsList"><li>3-Year Bachelor's Degree</li><li>4-Year Bachelor's Degree</li><li>Integrated Masters</li><li>Post-Secondary Certificate</li><li>Top-up Degree</li><li>Undergraduate Advanced Diploma</li><li>Undergraduate Diploma</li></ul></section><div class="scholarship-otherGrid"><article aria-label="View scholarship Brock Future Leaders Scholarship" class="share-scholarshipCard" data-sentry-component="ScholarshipCard" data-sentry-source-file="scholarship-card.tsx"><div class="share-scholarshipBody"><div class="share-scholarshipFields"><div><p class="share-scholarshipTitle">Brock Future Leaders Scholarship</p><p class="share-scholarshipGroup">Brock University</p><hr class="share-divider"/><div class="share-scholarshipField"><span class="share-fieldLabel">Amount</span><span>$10,000 CAD</span></div></div><div class="share-scholarshipField"><span class="share-fieldLabelRow"><span class="share-fieldLabel">Auto applied</span><button aria-describedby="scholarship-auto-applied-tooltip-y2Dhx0vYZTBWlRys0lUX-" aria-label="What does auto-applied mean?" class="share-infoButton" data-tooltip="Auto-applied means that after you apply to a program offering this scholarship, if you meet the eligibility requirements, the scholarship is granted automatically (i.e. no separate scholarship application is needed).
